source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Provide the new room number without additional clinical detail because the receiving nurse can locate the remaining information in the electronic record.","B":"Communicate current clinical status, treatment given, pending information, fall risk and precautions, and allow the receiving nurse to clarify questions.","C":"Provide billing, insurance, and transport details while omitting most clinical information because the chart already contains the medical record.","D":"Skip direct handoff communication because transferring responsibility through the electronic chart alone is sufficient without acknowledgment by the receiver."}}
source_row.rationale: A safe handoff transfers the information, responsibility, and accountability needed for the receiving team to continue care. Option B is correct because it communicates current status, treatment, pending information, fall risk and precautions, and supports clarification. Option A supplies only a location. Option C omits clinically essential information. Option D incorrectly assumes electronic documentation alone replaces acknowledged handoff communication.
source_row.source_detail: AHRQ TeamSTEPPS — Communication Module, Handoff: standardized transfer of information and responsibility/accountability during transitions; effective handoff conveys current condition, care/treatment and action/contingency information, requires receiver acknowledgment, and permits clarification/questions. Current AHRQ TeamSTEPPS Communication Module; live federal resource rechecked 2026-08-15. Blueprint corrected from Safety/Infection to Management of Care because the tested competency is continuity/transfer of care. NCSBN first-check: Client Needs — Safe and Effective Care Environment — Management of Care: continuity/transfer of care, collaboration, legal/regulatory scope, quality improvement, leadership and professional-practice activities as applicable. 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan; effective 2026-04-01 through 2029-03-31; currentness rechecked 2026-08-15.
source_row.stem: A client is transferred from the emergency department to an inpatient unit after receiving a new IV antibiotic and being identified as high fall risk. What should the handoff include?
